Conferment of Powers under Co-operative Societies Statute No. 03 of 1998 of the Western ProvinceProvincial Council

IN pursuance of the powers vested in me by Section 02(2) of the Co-operative Statute No. 03 of 1998 and the ProvincialCouncil (Consequential Provisions) Act, No. 12 of 1989, Kagiton Lalith Wanigarathna, Minister of Fisheries, Roads,Transport, Co-operative Development and Trade, Housing and Construction, State Infrastructure Facilities, Industrial andRural Development in Western Province do by this order confer on the persons specified in Column I to assist theCommissioner of Co-operative Development and the Registrar of Co-operative Societies of Western Province and specifiedin Schedule I from the date specified in Column II, such powers of Commissioner of Co-operative Development and theRegistrar of Co-operative Societies under Section 2(2) of the Co-operative Societies Statute No. 03 of 1998 and therules stated in the Section 72(2) of the above Statute as specified in Column III of the said Schedule.

KAGITON LALITH WANIGARATHNA,Minister of Fisheries, Roads, Transport, Co-operative Developmentand Trade, Housing and Construction, EstateInfrastructure Facilities, Industrial andRural Development in Western Province.29th September 2015.
PRINTED AT THE DEPARTMENT OF GOVERNMENT PRINTING, SRI LANKA.1A

All powers of the Registrar under Sections 2(3), 4,(Except 4(2)), 5, 6, 7, 8, 33, 43(A), 43(B), 44, (Except44(6)), 45, 46, 47, 50, 52, 53, 54, (Except 54(2), 58(2)),59, 67, 68, 69, 74 and 76 of the Western Province Co-operative Societies Statute No. 03 of 1998 and allpowers of the Registrar under Rules 4, 11, 15, 16(ii),19, 27, 32, 37, 39, 40, 41, 42, 49, 52 and 53.
